Name: Bethuel
Summary: Bethuel was the youngest son of Nahor and Milcah, and the father of Rebekah and Laban.
KeyStory: Bethuel's daughter Rebekah became Isaac's wife, tying Nahor's family to the promise line.
RelatedPeople: Nahor, Brother of Abraham; Milcah; Rebekah; Laban
LifeLesson: God's story keeps moving through families we know almost nothing about — and He knows them all.
